data.subject: Local Ledger for BANC FUNDS
data.body:
Hi,

BANC FUNDS CO LLC’s most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in ISTR and AVBH.

ISTR reported Q2 2026 total interest income of $53.2M versus $35.4M a year earlier, a 50.5% year-over-year increase (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1602658/000143774926026348/0001437749-26-026348-index.htm)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records such as permits, agendas, call reports, and filings, with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and details on a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
